settings.address: 8 Cloonagh Road, Downpatrick, County Down, BT30 6LJ
settings.registered_address: 3 Cloonagh Road, Downpatrick, Co Down, BT30 6LJ
settings.about: An independent equipment hire business established by Ken Turley, serving Downpatrick and County Down. The existing website reports over 25 years of experience and offers short and long term hire for construction, agriculture, garden and home projects. Equipment advice and delivery are available.

services.title: Plant hire
services.short: Equipment for site work, groundwork and construction.
services.body: Excavators, site dumpers and supporting equipment for projects across County Down. Ask the team about your site, access and hire period to choose suitable equipment.

services.title: Garden equipment
services.short: Professional equipment for garden and landscaping work.
services.body: Garden equipment hire for residential and commercial customers, with advice on choosing tools and a delivery service across County Down.

services.title: Tool hire
services.short: Tools for home improvements and commercial projects.
services.body: A choice of power tools for short and long term hire. Discuss the job with the team for equipment advice and a quotation.

services.title: Storage containers
services.body: The existing website offers storage container hire, sales and transport. Contact the team to discuss your storage needs, location and delivery access.
